evidence.quote: A method of counting occupants of a room monitored by a first sensor and a second sensor with an overlap region, comprising: at each sensor, counting persons locally and counting persons within the overlap region; transmitting only the counts; and computing a room count as the sum of the counts minus the overlap count.
